name: overture
description: Overture and Cadence — sibling orchestrators: Overture drafts, aligns on, and publishes cross-functional proposals; Cadence tracks execution — commitments, capacity, injections, and the ledger that explains every date change.

plugins.name: overture-orchestrator
plugins.description: Draft, align on, and publish cross-functional proposals, with a structurally private context zone and a leak-check verifier on every outbound path.

plugins.name: cadence-orchestrator
plugins.description: Track execution state: de-aliased commitments, capacity-aware forecasts from measured cycle times, an append-only ledger behind every date change, and human-approved fan-out to Jira/Confluence.
